text:
Type: small shaggy high-pile rug
Use: a soft landing by a bed or sofa; bedroom, living room, children's room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: dense long shag pile, soft curly yarn
Colors: light warm grey, off-white flecks
Shape: small rectangle with thick tight shag texture, plush and soft underfoot, compact, cushy
Feel: cosy, soft, warm, calm
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, white bedding, knit throws; Scandinavian or contemporary bedrooms

product.name: ALHEDE
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
